name: enhancement-spark-opens-tree
description: Clicking the spark button in the player's top dock row opens the enhancement tree at its root.

steps.name: hasVideo
steps.note: The spark is a chrome affordance that exists before the stream does; waiting keeps the tree opening over a live player.
Click the real Quick enhancement menu button.

assertions.note: The controller reports its real Quick menu stack visible after the enhancement button's menuId request.
The settings panel remains closed; the requested menu id is enhancements.
The actual cached enhancement model has selectable rows for the opened CascadingMenu.
